newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 28.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 28.

text.p: -- Union workers voted to accept a contract offer at a General Motors Corp transmission and wheel plant, ending a four-day strike that had threatened to paralyze the company's North American production. GM shares closed at 56-7/8 Friday.

-- MainStreet BankGroup Inc said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Tysons Financial Corp in a stock swap. The deal valued Tysons at $14.50 per share. Tysons closed at 14 and MainStreet closed at 27-10/16.

-- Ford Motor Co is expected to announce this autumn the reorganization of its auto-parts manufacturing operations, a move that could bring the unit closer to a spinoff, the Wall Street Journal said. Ford finished at 40-9/16.
